concepts.body: Production-style Python sirf happy path nahi dekhta. Input invalid ho sakta hai, file missing ho sakti hai, network timeout aa sakta hai. Exception handling ka goal error ko chupana nahi, balki controlled behavior aur useful diagnostics dena hai. EXCEPTION FLOW try me risky code, except me expected recovery, else success path, finally cleanup ke liye. FILES pathlib + with open() use karo. Context manager resource ko close kar deta hai. JSON / CSV AI workflows me JSON payloads aur analytics me CSV/JSON export common hai. Schema validate karna useful hai. LOGGING print debugging ke bajay structured log messages use karo.
